title: Engineer reset 1:1 notes — career signals & next sprint
body:
Meeting: 1:1 prep for Ethan Park (report) — 2026-05-20
Location: async notes + in-person 30m
Goal: reset expectations after last sprint, align on promotion signals, unblock PR queue, agree on 2 concrete development goals for next 6 weeks.

Quick context (notes to self):
- Ethan has been owning the model-serving PR backlog; last promotion packet was not approved (feedback: needs more cross-team leadership evidence + clearer impact quant).
- PR throughput dropped from 6/wk -> 3/wk during oncall month (tracking in INF-2147). Some of that is context switching and flaky tests.
- Strong engineering craft and design notes in PRs, but limited upward communication / stakeholder writeups.
- Wants to shift toward more product-facing work but unsure how to surface impact.

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick personal check-in (3m) — mood, energy, what's on top
2) Review what went well / not last sprint (6m) — metrics talk (PR cycle time, number of reviewers, flaky test incidents)
3) Promotion feedback debrief & signal plan (8m) — clarify concrete evidence to gather
4) Roadmap alignment / project priorities (6m) — choose 2 things for next 6 weeks
5) Clear action items + confirm owners/dates (4m)

Metrics to surface (have these ready):
- PR cycle time: median 4.2 days last month; target <3 days.
- PR reviewed by >=2 engineers: 40% of PRs; target 70%.
- Flaky-test incidents blocking CI: 5 in past 2 weeks (see INF-2147).
- On-call load last month: 18 hrs, > team average (12 hrs).

Talking points / prompts:
- "Tell me one engineering win you're proud of in the last two sprints." (use to start positive)
- "Walk me through an example PR that took longer than expected — what were the blockers?"
- "What would meaningful leadership look like for you in the next 3 months? Who needs to notice?"
- "If we fixed flaky tests, where would that time go? Which projects would you accelerate?"

Promotion signals (convert feedback into evidence):
- Cross-team impact: pick 1 project to drive cross-team coordination and produce a 1-page stakeholder impact brief (owner: Ethan, deliverable: draft by 2026-06-04).
- Mentorship: lead 4 peer code review pull-ups and pair-review sessions; collect 3 short peer notes that describe mentoring moments (owner: Ethan, deliverable: 2026-06-15).
- Business impact: quantify latency/cost delta for one serving optimization (owner: Ethan + infra), aim to show >=10% cost/token improvement or >=5% p99 latency win (deliverable: mid-June).

Draft proposals to offer in meeting (ways I can help):
- I will introduce Ethan at the weekly infra sync next Wed (2026-05-26) and ask him to present the serving optimization plan (quick 10m slot).
- I'll block 2 hours this Friday for pairing on flaky-test triage and CI runbook (we'll reduce noise).
- Sponsor a small "PR review blitz" next Tue: invite 3 reviewers, set goal to clear 6 outstanding PRs.

Potential risks / pushbacks (prep answers):
- "I'm burnt out from on-call" -> offer to rebalance on-call rota and protect 1 uninterrupted deep work day/week.
- "I don't have cross-team forum" -> propose concrete intro channels and calendared syncs; offer to co-create stakeholder brief.
- "Promotion timeline feels nebulous" -> commit to a visible 6-week plan with clear artifacts and check-ins.

Action items (confirm during meeting):
- Ethan: draft 1-page stakeholder impact brief for serving optimization, due 2026-06-04.
- Ethan: run and document 2 pairing sessions focused on flaky tests (invite: Tina), log short notes, due 2026-05-28.
- Ravi: set up 10m slot at infra sync (2026-05-26) and intro note to infra leads, done by 2026-05-21.
- Ravi: schedule PR review blitz and invite reviewers, scheduled for 2026-05-25.
- Both: biweekly check-ins on promotion artifacts (first checkpoint 2026-06-01).

Scratch / unpolished thoughts (notes to self to keep in doc):
- Could measure reviewer load per PR (reviewer-hours) to better argue for reviewer allocation.
- Consider a lightweight "review champion" rota for high-risk PRs.
- If promotion requires stakeholder letters, start identifying potential recommenders now (Ops lead, Infra tech lead).

Unresolved questions to raise in 1:1:
- Do you prefer to lead a small cross-team project now or take a product-facing PM-collab? Which feels higher leverage?
- What's one blocker I can remove this week to shift your focus?

Post-meeting follow-up template (to send as Slack DM / gist):
- TL;DR: agreed 2 goals (stakeholder brief + flaky test pairing), key dates, and next checkpoint.
- Attach: PR cycle time snapshot + INF-2147 link + rough draft of stakeholder brief template.

Tone notes for meeting: direct, supportive, concrete. Avoid vague pep talk. Be explicit about visibility artifacts we need for promotion.

Version history (scratch):
- 2026-05-17 created: baseline notes and metrics
- 2026-05-20 edited: added action owners and tighter deadlines after chat with Tina

End.
